title: FancyZones improperly sizes some windows when shift-dragging
author: khanfluence

status.label: Ready for focused reproduction
status.detail: The report is reproducible with public software and includes immediate expected/actual geometry.

next_action.label: E
next_action.reason: Run a requested-versus-final bounds matrix for affected apps across monitor DPI values.

judgment.rationale: The report is reproducible with public software and includes immediate expected/actual geometry.
evidence: GIMP, Audacity, and yEd fail while Calculator succeeds.
The failure occurs at snap completion, not after a later app resize.
judgment.recommended_action: Run a requested-versus-final bounds matrix for affected apps across monitor DPI values.

fix_assessment.rationale: No existing fix attempt covers this app-specific geometry mismatch.

issue_context.summary: FancyZones immediately applies incorrect size or position to some desktop applications such as GIMP, Audacity, and yEd when Shift-dragging into a zone.
known_information: The issue supplies a multi-monitor zone screenshot, a recording, two diagnostic archives, and affected public applications.
The wrong bounds appear immediately after the drag ends.
Calculator zones correctly in the same layout, so the layout itself is not universally wrong.
inferences: Affected applications may enforce min/max client constraints or non-client frame adjustments that FancyZones does not reconcile after SetWindowPos.
issue_context.analysis: The public apps and layout make this suitable for a local matrix test. Comparing requested zone bounds with final extended-frame and client bounds will distinguish DPI conversion from application constraints.
initial_investigation: No upstream pull request referencing issue 23780 was found.
Current FancyZones has separate window eligibility, placement, and DPI/work-area calculations that can be instrumented without reporter-only assets.

actions.label: Design fix
actions.note: Start the bounded fork-side design workflow. This draft performs no upstream write.

actions.label: E
actions.note: Local maintainer verification only; no GitHub write is performed.

proposed_fixes.title: Reconcile FancyZones target bounds with application frame constraints
proposed_fixes.root_cause: Best current hypothesis: FancyZones applies zone rectangle coordinates without compensating for per-window non-client/DPI constraints or without verifying the final bounds after the application processes the move.
plan: Log target zone, monitor DPI, WINDOWPLACEMENT, extended-frame bounds, and final bounds for successful and failing apps.
Use the correct DPI-aware frame adjustment and avoid double-applying offsets between monitor coordinate spaces.
Where an app enforces constraints, detect the final mismatch and apply a bounded corrective placement that respects minimum size.
verification: Shift-drag GIMP, Audacity, yEd, and Calculator into the same zones on equal- and mixed-DPI monitors and compare final bounds to the zone.

confidence.rationale: The app-specific immediate geometry points to frame/DPI constraints, but measurements are needed to choose offset conversion versus post-move correction.
